prompt:
Create a complete high-fidelity desktop product UI concept image at 1600x1000 landscape for Molis Work PROJECT HOME. Use the supplied onboarding screenshot as a reference for its radical whitespace, calm sentence-like interaction, low visual weight and precise Chinese sans-serif typography. Do not copy onboarding's form or content. The user NOW requires its palette aligned to the main app: clean neutral white #ffffff content, very pale cool gray #f8f9fb sidebar, charcoal #272932, secondary #60636f, very restrained violet #6262d6. No beige, brown, sage green, photography, illustration or decorative blobs. This is a real usable app surface, NOT a poster.
STRUCTURE, concept A “A letter to today”: Preserve a narrow 220px left application sidebar with small Molis Work project name and entries 项目首页 (selected), Goals, Sessions, Feed, Artifacts; small settings at bottom. Right page has a tiny topbar “项目首页”. Main content is a sophisticated asymmetrical letter composition, not a dashboard or stacked sections. A letter-sized text measure occupies the LEFT half of the remaining page, beginning around 37% down the viewport, leaving a lot of untouched white above. A tiny dateline “2026年9月12日 · 星期六” sits modestly near upper-left of main. The dominant Chinese prose is exactly “把今天，\n写进正在发生的事。” in refined medium-weight sans-serif, around 38px, generous line-height; its scale is editorial but restrained. Below, a compact quoted line “千里之行，始于足下。” and attribution “老子 ·《道德经》” with tiny previous/pause/next controls. Below, an unfinished sentence “今天，我想” followed by a SINGLE long hairline input field, placeholder “让这个项目，再往前一步…” and a tiny arrow at its right; this is the clear next interaction. Discreet helper “草稿已保留 · Agent 即将接入”. No large rounded chat box.
A quiet narrow MARGIN column sits on the far right, asymmetrically slightly lower than the headline, with tiny heading “上次，我们走到这里” and three sparse recent-activity snippets each with a small timestamp and one short underlined working title: “09:42 · 体验新的 Goal 工作区”, “昨天 · 接通终端与目标信息”, “周四 · 留下第一份工作记录”. No enclosing cards, no table, no repeated row dividers. A tiny “查看全部 →” affordance ends the margin. Near bottom main content small understated project context “Molis Work · 开发预览”. Focal interaction and line remain readable; all five requested elements date, quotation, real-looking sample recent activity, Agent composer and sidebar must be visible. Poetic sophistication comes from asymmetry, empty space and sentence continuity, not flourishes. Screen-perfect crisp Chinese text, great spacing, no logos beyond Molis Work, no watermark, no concept titles or callout annotations inside the image.
